quick: 25 to 50 mg once or twice daily
summary: Phenformin is a biguanide withdrawn in most countries since the 1970s because of a high rate of fatal lactic acidosis. Metformin replaced it. Do not start phenformin.

dosage.d: 25 to 50 mg once or twice daily
dosage.n: Do not prescribe; switch to metformin

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis; inhibits mitochondrial respiration more strongly than metformin.

absolute: All patients: withdrawn for lactic acidosis

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: Lactic acidosis: haemodialysis and supportive care.
